description: High-end villa at the gates of Paris, ideal for private stays and exclusive events.Elegant reception spaces, generous volumes, landscaped outdoor areas, and a truly confidential atmosphere.The property features 7 fully air-conditioned bedrooms and 7 bathrooms, offering absolute comfort for groups. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed and fully equipped to embody refined luxury.A dedicated lower-level entertainment space includes a billiard room, lounge area and a night club space.The spaceTreat yourself to more than just a stay: a truly private Parisian experience.Nestled in a sought-after residential area west of Paris, this exceptional villa embodies the timeless elegance of grand Parisian residences, while offering spaces designed for hosting.At the crossroads between a prestigious home and a confidential reception venue, it caters to a discerning clientele seeking volume, discretion, and flexibility of use.A villa designed for living… and hostingFrom the moment you enter, the scale is striking: high ceilings, abundant natural light, and a seamless flow between spaces.The heart of the home revolves around elegant reception areas, ideal for:*Private dinners*Intimate gatherings*High-end meetings*Product launches or presentations*Photoshoots & film productionsThe overall atmosphere evokes a private Parisian salon, blending classic refinement with contemporary comfort.*Living spaces*Spacious, light-filled reception lounge*Welcoming dining room*Additional areas allowing for flexible layouts*Fully equipped kitchen (suited for private chefs / catering)Each space has been designed to ensure a seamless experience between private living and event use.Sleeping areaThe villa features several spacious bedrooms, allowing comfortable group stays while preserving privacy and
